newsitem.title: UK: Greece sets two 50 billion yen Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Greece sets two 50 billion yen Eurobonds.

text.p: Greece has launched two 50 billion yen Eurobonds, with 10- and 20-year maturities, joint lead managers Goldman Sachs International and Nomura International said on Monday.
The 10-year carries a 2.90 percent semi-annual coupon and was reoffered at 99.76.
The 20-year carries a 3.80 percent semi-annual coupon and was reoffered at par.
